content.text:
Now the mobile overlay covers the whole court. It looked OK, but stats behind overlay show through at top. That's because the overlay gradient is transparent. The stat box visible at top-left behind is a bit noisy. On mobile, maybe hide statbox when overlay is shown. Could add `#game:not(.active) .statbox, #game:not(.active) .shotclock{opacity:0}`. And add `active` class on start, remove on end/pause? Pause should keep HUD? The overlay covers, could keep active on pause. Let's hide stats/shotclock only when overlay is start screen (not started). Use body class.

Also on mobile the overlay title takes 2 lines well. The CTA row text is clipped a bit ("60 SECONDS ON THE CLOCK HOW HOT CAN YOU GET?"). It's okay but wrapping narrow. Could hide subhint on mobile or make smaller. The rules row overlaps the "START YOUR RUN" arrow? The arrow appears wrapped below the button text: "START YOUR RUN ↗" wraps to second line because button width constrained. Need white-space:nowrap on play button.

Also mobile tip text overlaps with stick? bottom text center. Fine.

For desktop, pause pill will overlap "LIVE RUN" at top? It's right side below topbar; at right 56px, top 24px would be exactly on top of live indicator. In screenshot, "PAUSE" overlaps the LIVE RUN text. Need move pause pill below, e.g., top:52px, right:56px. On mobile top 52 might overlap shot clock at 132. Actually on mobile pause at top 14 right 15 overlapped live text too. Let's position pause at top center-right near scoreboard? Better: right side under live indicator (top 54px desktop). On mobile, top 68 right 12? That may collide with scoreboard (centered, width ~200 at 390, right edge ~295). Pause pill width ~70, right 12 -> starts 308. fine. But the pause pill was hidden before game.

Wait, my CSS for visibility hidden is applied on pause pill but that also means during play it shows. Good.

Also statbox top 104 on mobile at 128 earlier; with muddle. When overlay active hide UI elements.

Let's update: `#game:not(.active) .statbox,#game:not(.active) .shotclock{opacity:0}`. And toggling active in startGame/endGame. When endGame overlay shows, hide HUD stats too; fine.

Also on mobile, when overlay is up, hide touch controls? The touch controls are visible behind overlay but overlay z-index 8 above z 5, so they show dim behind. It looked visually noisy (stick ring visible under overlay). Better hide touch controls until active. `#game:not(.active) .touch-controls{display:none}` but mobile media sets display:flex later? Specificity higher with ID. use `#game:not(.active) .touch-controls{display:none!important}`.

Let's apply.

The game runs static via python server, browser internet may or may not be available. Safer to build a 3D game using WebGL raw or with Three.js bundled locally. Can we fetch three.js? Let's check network availability. We have webfetch tool; could download three.module.js locally. But 3D basketball game with physics and visuals.

Plan: Rewrite index.html to use Three.js (download three.min.js or module). Use CDN import with local fallback? Download from unpkg via curl and save to vendor/three.module.js. Check network.

Game design: half-court 3D, camera behind player, player moves with WASD, defender AI, charge and release shot with 3D ball arc to hoop. HUD unchanged. Use three.js for rendering.

Now build a 3D game. Need thought about design quality. "NBA 2K27" originally then "Make it 3d". We should preserve the UI style but make gameplay 3D and much richer.

Architecture:
- Three.js scene, half-court, night arena atmosphere.
- Camera: broadcast follow cam behind player angled toward hoop. Player moves in x/z plane; hoop at z = -13 (far), player starts z = 2.
- Court dimensions: half court width 15m, length 14m; hoop at (0,-13?). Let's define coordinates: court centered x=0, z from -14 (baseline) to +1 (half court). Hoop at (0,-12.2), height 3.05. Player starts (0, 2). 3pt arc radius ~6.75 centered at hoop.
- Backboard, rim torus, net cylinder lines, stanchion/pole.
- Court floor with painted key, 3pt line as line geometry, center circle, glossy reflection using MeshPhysicalMaterial maybe with environment map.
- Lighting: hemisphere, key spotlights with shadows, colored rim lights (teal and lime).
- Crowd: instanced boxes/blobs behind baseline and sides; dark silhouette rows. Grandstand tiers maybe.
- Player & defender low-poly humanoid with animation (bobbing, arms), jersey numbers. Could use capsules/spheres and simple limb animation. Build using groups with body parts; animate legs/arms while moving. Player lime jersey, defender red.
- Ball: sphere with seams via texture drawn on canvas, or line overlays. Use canvas texture for basketball with lines.
- Ball physics: shot arc with parabola; on release launch toward rim with velocity computed to reach rim; arc height. Use physics simulation with gravity, bounce off rim/backboard. Since accuracy determined by timing, when made ensure ball passes through hoop; if missed add lateral/forward error and bounce off rim.
- Movement: x/z; clamp to court; sprint.
- Defender: mirror-ish AI positioning between player and hoop, lateral cut, arms up when shooting. collision.
- Camera: follow player smoothly at (player.x*0.35, 5.4, player.z+8.5) looking toward hoop/player blend. On shot, small cut/follow ball? Keep camera but maybe zoom slightly.
- Shadows: directional light shadow map.
- HUD: same but adapted. Add shot meter. On mobile: joystick 3D movement + shoot button. Screen size.

Performance: Need to run in SwiftShader possibly (headless chromium with Vulkan). Keep low poly, shadow map 1024, antialias true maybe.

Need to replace existing index.html script entirely with module. Keep HTML/CSS, adjust subtitle and overlay to 3D? Add "3D" hint. The result screens.

Game loop: requestAnimationFrame with clock delta.

Details:

Coordinate setup:
- Scene units meters. Court width 15 (x -7.5..7.5), half length 14 (z -14..0). Hoop center (0, 3.05, -12.4).
- Player radius .45.
- Movement bounds x -7..7, z -11.5..1.5.
- Camera behind player with offset (0, 4.6, 7.6) from player, look at point between player and hoop: target (player.x*0.5, 1.3, player.z-4). Actually a broadcast side-ish view can be better for aiming. Use camera positioned at (player.x*0.4+0.4, 5.2, player.z+8.2), lookAt(hoop.x, 1.4, (player.z+hoop.z)/2). This gives view of hoop.

Aiming: Auto-aim toward hoop with timing-based accuracy. Player does not aim manually (keyboard). Could allow A/D strafing. On mobile joystick.

Shot mechanics: hold Space charges; release sets quality from charge relative to perfect zone 0.78-0.9. Compute make probability. Ball flight to hoop:
Compute release point = player shoulder (x, 1.9, z).
Target = rim center (0,3.05,-12.4) or miss offset.
For made: travel time ~0.9s, use gravity solution: choose apex height additional. Simpler use parametric arc: p(t) = start + (target-start)*t + vertical offset sin(pi t)*arcHeight. Ball rotates. Then at t >= 1, if made, pass through net, fall to floor and bounce. Also animate net swish (net deformation) maybe rotate net rings? Keep subtle.
For missed: target offset by error (x, z). Ball arc then hits rim/backboard and bounce with velocity. Simpler: animate arc to miss target then bounce off floor with 2 bounces, fade? After resolve, ball resets to player.

Defender contest: increases missed probability.

Scoring, clock, shot clock as before. Add quarter? Keep 60 sec.

Also add player scoring streak and "best" localStorage.

Environment:
- Background floor outside court dark, arena walls with band lighting, crowd silhouettes (instanced cones?). Make it visually rich: dark teal arena, glowing lime signage "COURTSIDE" on wall behind hoop using canvas texture plane. Crowd rows placed behind baseline and along sides. Spotlights with volumetric cones (transparent cones).
- Add haze via fog.

Add overhead light pools with additive circular gradient texture planes on the floor (baked look). Actually floor texture via canvas: wood planks gradient + court lines drawn into texture! That's efficient and crisp. Draw 1024x1024 texture with wooden planks and lines in canvas; apply to plane. That gives everything (key, 3pt, center logo) at once. Use anisotropy.

But we also want geometry for lines? Texture is fine. Court texture size 1024x1024 mapping planes.

Lighting for characters with shadows: directional light casting shadow onto floor.

Ball texture canvas 256: orange with black seams.

Player model: Use group:
- torso: capsule/cylinder with jersey color and shoulders.
- head: sphere skin, hair band.
- legs: two cylinders attached at hips, animate swing rotation x.
- arms: cylinders, one up on defense; for player, ball-holding arms bent.
- number: canvas texture plane on chest? Or simple white circle. Use sprite text "0" on chest via canvas texture plane attached front. Maybe simpler: mesh with small plane textured "0".
Need character orientation toward hoop (rotate y=0). Player runs toward hoop so faces -z. Defender faces +z.

Animation: limbs swing based on speed. Dribble? Add a ball dribble animation when ball held: ball bounces near player's right hand. That adds life. Ball object world position when idle = beside player with sine bounce. On shot, animate arc. This is important: ball visible during play, dribbling.

Shot release: ball starts from hand pos and arcs to hoop.

Also add shot meter as 3D? HUD 2D meter is fine.

Camera shake on made shot? Slight.

SFX: WebAudio beeps as before; add crowd noise? Could synthesize noise for arena ambience, but autoplay restrictions. Simple positive tones.

Pause overlay uses 3D? Just pause.

Adapt overlay: "3D" note; copy "A 3D half-court run".

Ensure top of texture (v=1) at z=-14 (baseline) if rotation right. Use drawing orientation then test screenshot. If reversed, lines look wrong. Let's reason: PlaneGeometry(w,h) lies in XY with +Y up; rotate -PI/2 about X: local (x,y,0) -> world (x, 0, -y)? Rotation about X by -90: y' = y cos(-90) - z sin(-90) = 0 + z*0 =0; z' = y sin(-90) + z cos(-90) = -y. So local +Y -> world -Z. UV v=1 at local +y -> world -z (baseline). Canvas texture: v=1 corresponds top of canvas (row 0). So canvas top = baseline. Good, draw baseline at top.

- Backboard: transparent white-ish plane with border, at z=-13.3? Hoop rim extends 0.375m from backboard; rim center z = -12.4 means backboard z=-12.775. Standard backboard 1.8w x 1.05h, bottom 2.9m, top 3.95. Place board at (0, 3.05+0.3, -13.0), rim center (0,3.05,-12.35). Let's set backboard z=-12.9, rim center z=-12.35. Rim radius 0.23.

Animate net when score: store net base positions, apply sway. Could simpler scale animation. Let's build line segments and add a subtle sway via rotating group. Score flash.

- 3D signage on wall behind: plane with canvas texture "COURTSIDE" lime on dark, at z=-16.5,y=6.5, plus side banners.

Simpler: two instanced meshes: body (box 0.5x0.8x0.4) and head (icosahedron). 300 each. Positioned in stands at y tiers behind baseline z=-17..-22 and sides x=±10..13, raised. Camera mostly sees baseline crowd, so focus there.

### Ran Playwright code

```
### Page

```
### Page

### Snapshot
- [Snapshot](../../../.local/share/omgithub-playwright/output/page-2026-11-11T09-49-45-628Z.yml)
### Result
- [Screenshot of viewport](screenshots/play3d.jpg)
### Ran Playwright code
```js
// Screenshot viewport and save it as screenshots/play3d.jpg
await page.screenshot({
  path: 'screenshots/play3d.jpg',
  quality: 90,
  scale: 'css',
  type: 'jpeg'
});
```
Image read successfully

Gameplay view looks good! Issues:
- Player and defender look like they're facing away? Player back jersey number "0" visible (good) but the head skin is dark and hairless. Defender is facing player? Defender jersey 7 visible = back facing camera, so defender faces hoop not player. Wait poseDefender face = atan2(-dx,-dz). player z=1.5, defender z=-2.4 => dz=3.9; dx=0 -> atan2(0,-3.9)=PI. Rotation PI for model default forward -z -> forward +z, facing player. Camera sees defender's back? If defender faces +z (toward camera), we'd see chest; but number 7 appears on back. Hmm the number is on both front and back, but the front plane is at z=-0.31 rotated PI. At rotation PI, the front plane faces +z toward camera. So we see "7" on chest. Fine, but the body shape makes it look like back. No face/hair. Add simple face mask/eyes? Could improve. Add hair cap and facial features (eyes) to show orientation.

- Player at bottom, ball beside right hand (camera bottom right), good.
- Camera framing: lots of space above hoop, sign visible. The player is near bottom, could raise camera look slightly. The HUD covers top. It's good but the player's feet are very near screen bottom (y=550 of 576?). Screenshot 1024x576; player feet at 525. Bottom HUD at 540 overlaps slightly. Maybe raise look target or lower camera pitch a touch so player higher. Set look y 1.7? Raising look target moves scene down? Camera lookAt higher → horizon lower? Actually looking up shifts scene down. Look y higher would move player lower. We want player up → look lower (y 1.2) or camera down. Hmm. Player at z=1.5, camera z=7.85, y=3.82. To move player higher on screen, camera should look further down (lower look target) — that shifts everything up? If camera pitches down, the floor near player fills more bottom, player moves up. Yes look lower. Or move camera closer.

Maybe camera y=4.4, look at z=-5.2 y=1.3. Not critical.

- Lighting: scene is quite dark around the court and very dark bottom; dramatic. Characters lit. Good.
- The court appears tilted/perspective fine. But court looks like full court? Only half court with center logo at bottom near player; yes bottom center logo at the player. Good.
- Hoop at 3.05 and very small because far. Could enlarge by shortening court? NBA halfcourt 14m. It's acceptable; aiming is automatic.
- The "COURTSIDE" sign is huge and centered. Looks good.
- Scoreboard/pause overlapping? Pause at top right under live, okay. Shot clock at top 105 right; pause at 56. Good.
- Statbox top-left; good.
- Bottom-right action contains a white box around SPACE? `.key` maybe okay, but text overlaps weirdly "SPACEROLD · RELEASE" at bottom right (key + label). It appears cramped. In screenshot bottom right "SPACEROLD · RELEASE" – because `.action` has key "SPACE" then " HOLD · RELEASE", but the key is narrow and space missing. It rendered "SPACEHOLD · RELEASE" because font. Need add gap (exists 8px) maybe screenshot small. Actually key width 25 too small for "SPACE" (5 chars at 10px = 30px), overflow. Set key width auto, padding 0 7px, min-width 25. Then it will be "SPACE HOLD · RELEASE". Fix.

- Difficulty: defender stands right in front of player, almost overlapping, pressure will steal in 4s without moving. Player must move/shoot.

- Need 3D depth: shadows visible under characters? Player shadow not obvious; looks slightly. Could enable stronger shadow.

Next test shooting. Use `window.__cs.start()`, then hold ~0.9 sec to green. The charge rate 0.9/s, perfect at .84 => 0.93s. Release. Then screenshot mid-flight and after resolution. Let's run.
